newsitem.title: USA: Albright welcomes U.N. reform propsals.
newsitem.headline: Albright welcomes U.N. reform propsals.

text.p: Secretary of State Madeleine Albright welcomed U.N. Secretary-General Kofi Annan's U.N. reform proposals on Wednesday and said the United States would push the General Assembly to act quickly on them.

"The United States was very pleased to see the reform proposals introduced today...We have not had time to review the proposals in detail but heartily endorse their focus on improving management and efficiencies, cutting costs and emphasising the U.N.'s core missions," she told reporters.
